notes: Transcribed in full from the Westinghouse page only. No Nordyne import and no usesStylesOf: the page's own text positions are encoded, following the program's established character-counting convention for this page family (digit-only counting is falsified by the Style 1 example: digits of FGA030310579 give 4th & 5th numerical digits '31', unresolvable, while character counting gives year '03' = 2003 and month '03' = March). Parent per page: Nortek (formerly Nordyne Manufacturing); Westinghouse Electric is a different scope and nothing is taken from it. Page Styles 5 (1980-1984, M38778) and the second Style 5 heading (1970-1979, A16789) are HELD entirely: month (1st character) and year (2nd character) are both chart letters with no text table.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-based, character counting: year = 4th & 5th positions, month = 6th & 7th positions. Year/month values derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.

Page positions 1-based, character counting over the space-stripped serial (page states the space does not count): year = 3rd & 4th characters. Page example shown as 'F3891 4228'; normalized form used here. Year value derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter + digit + letter + 9 digits (Building Center Style 3)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-based, character counting over the dash-stripped serial: year = 4th & 5th positions, month = 6th & 7th positions. Page example shown as 'G6R9905-05028'; normalized form used here. Year/month values derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.

styles.era: 9-character serials, 5 digits + dash + 2 digits + letter (Building Center Style 4)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-based: year = 7th & 8th positions (the two numbers following the dash), month = last (9th) character (letter chart image WESTINGHOUSE-4-Serial-Number.jpg only, held), so this style ships year-only. On the normalized (dash-stripped) serial the year digits sit at 0-based [5, 7]. Page example shown as '21584-97B'; normalized form used here. Year value derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.
